items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: I got so tired. ... I am disturbed with Joe Glaser because he knew they were going to make “High Society,” and he didn’t say to me... so they made “High Society” and I don’t want to look at that movie because I should have been on that movie.

ctx.x: Palisades Park? Well when we played Palisades Park in New Jersey, Cliffside, someplace, and we used to do on Saturdays a matinee, and right across the park was an Italian restaurant. And we’d go there for dinner. And Joe knew the bosses, which didn’t matter anyway, but we would sit there and he would tell us stories, and we did more © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-

laughing than eating because he was a very funny guy. There were stories about Joe Venuti that you don’t believe, and I’ve got some in my book that are incredible. About one where we were working at a park in Lincoln, not Nebraska, Lincoln Park in Massachusetts someplace, Bedford, Mass. Anyway, it was an outdoor park, it was an amusement park, and it was September and we were freezing. Guys were wearing overcoats and gloves. I was playing piano with gloves on, so was Joe.
